info.title: [VGE-D-TTD02] Title Trial Deck 02 “Record of Ragnarok” ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
D-TTD02/001EN
Man's Survival at Stake, Brunhilde
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), [COST][Counter-Blast]2 & Soul-Blast]1 card with "Brunhilde" in its card name], look at seven cards from the top of your deck, choose up to one <Man> and <Valkyrie> card each from among them, call them to (RC), and shuffle the rest and put them on the bottom of your deck.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Soul-Blast]1], choose two of your <Man> or <Valkyrie>, and they get [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

D-TTD02/002EN
Watching for an Opportunity, Brunhilde
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding on "The Choice for Victory, Brunhilde", reveal the top card of your deck, and if that grade 2 or less normal unit card is a <Man> or <Valkyrie>, call it to (RC), and if not, put it on the top of your deck or into your soul.

D-TTD02/003EN
The Choice for Victory, Brunhilde
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed by riding on "Brunhilde", [COST][Soul-Blast]1], look at the top card of your deck, put it on the top or bottom of your deck, and draw a card.

D-TTD02/004EN
Brunhilde
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-TTD02/005EN
Seeking the Strongest Opponent, Lü Bu
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit is boosted by a <Valkyrie>, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

D-TTD02/006EN
Prodigious Love, Adam
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](GC):If your grade 3 or greater vanguard is a <Man> or <Valkyrie>, this unit gets [Shield] +5000.

D-TTD02/007EN
Now in His Prime, Kojiro Sasaki
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
-

D-TTD02/008EN
Devoting Herself, Randgriz
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts a rear-guard with "Lü Bu" in its card name, if your grade 3 or greater vanguard is a unit with "Lü Bu" in its card name or a <Valkyrie>, [COST][Counter-Blast]1], and until end of that battle, when your opponent would call cards from hand to (GC), they must call two or more at the same time.

D-TTD02/009EN
Devoting Herself, Reginleif
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When this unit boosts a rear-guard with "Adam" in its card name, if your grade 3 or greater vanguard is a unit with "Adam" in its card name or a <Valkyrie>, [COST][Counter-Blast]1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn. At the end of that battle, return that boosted unit to your hand.

D-TTD02/010EN
Wishing for Man's Victory, Göll
Normal Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-TTD02/011EN
The Moment History is Transformed
Trigger Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn!

D-TTD02/012EN
The "Strongest" by Nature
Trigger Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)
[CONT]:You may have up to eight "The "Strongest" by Nature" in your deck.

D-TTD02/013EN
Men Battle with their Fists
Trigger Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)
[CONT]:You may have up to eight "Men Battle with their Fists" in your deck.

D-TTD02/014EN
Battle in the Abyss
Trigger Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn!)
[CONT]:You may have up to eight "Battle in the Abyss" in your deck.

D-TTD02/015EN
Adoring Gaze
Trigger Unit｜ Record of Ragnarok｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)
